title: Feeling awkward / social skills
content: Feeling awkward in social situations is extremely common, even for people who look confident, it tends to fade with familiarity and practice, not by waiting to feel ready first. A few things that help broadly: asking open follow-up questions, showing genuine curiosity about the other person, and not worrying too much about silences, which usually feel longer to you than to them.
